QuestInfo.name: [Hieizan Temple] Sad Little Boy
QuestInfo.0: You saw a young boy in tears when you entered Hieizan. Suspicious!
QuestInfo.1: The boy says he's with the alliance army. He was asleep when they brought him here and saw the men turn strange. He wants you to get his stuff before he tells you more. Take a look around the bushes.
QuestInfo.2: You got his bag back. Time to find out more about the fate of the alliance army.
